notes: 1’ jog recovery between reps and 3’ total jog recovery between sets. Wanted to focus on hitting faster paces today and succeeded. Not quite third lung good but the cooler air was 👌🏻
Humidity was back in full force and I felt sluggish for those first few miles.

8 miles normal before the first first 3 mi progression, 1 mile easy in between, and 2 miles easy to round out 17. SiS Beta Fuel during the 12th mile in between progressions plus water from the handheld throughout. Despite the humidity was able to hit a solid workout.
Started at 7.2 mph, progressed to 8 mph with stops at 7.6, 7.7, and 7.8 along the way.
Humid but feel decently acclimated at this point. This was one of the best workouts I’ve had in a while, solid paces despite the humidity outside of the 5th rep.
Even just a few degrees cooler feels so much better and it didn’t look like I’d been swimming afterwards.
Lap and a half around the Petal to the Medal course in between stints of walk/jog with Courtney
Probably the best in long run surges yet. Focused more today on keeping the pace decent in the recovery between surges. No water and no gels during this week.
Run felt good but first time in 20 years of running that I got buzzed by some sort of big bird, a hawk or owl.
1’ jog recovery between. These felt smooth! A tiny bit cooler this morning, which helped but mainly fitness may finally be coming around.
Nice and easy recovery run at Triple C with Dan and Mike
It felt okay but the summer humidity was back in full force with the slightly later start and it looked like I had emerged from a swimming pool afterwards.
Nice and easy uphill treadmill cross training session.

Mentally broke the 10 miles steady to finish into 3x3mi plus 1 mi where I tried to work down to marathon effort. First two 3 mile segments felt pretty good and controlled but then between the false flat and the humidity I was hanging on a little in those last 4 miles.
Easy run from the house felt good after the first couple of miles.
1’45” jog between reps and 4’ jog between sets. Really consistent splits and it felt hard but under control and like I definitely won that workout.
Pair of demo Ghosts. Nice catching up with Dan again. Two weeks in a row of CCC!
Easy double lap of the mountain bike trails at North Meck, which I didn’t realize had re-opened. There’s also new greenway but I didn’t explore that at all today.
8 mi easy to start and then 2 mi easy between reps. First felt great, second rep was a struggle those last 3 miles but we did it with 33:01 and 33:22 splits.
Legs still felt trashed from Saturday’s long run and yesterday’s lift but the weather was glorious.
2x4x2’ with 1’15” jog recovery between reps and 4’ between sets. Breathing and aerobic system felt great but I couldn’t turn the legs over much faster and that felt like the real limiter today.
Short and easy uphill treadmill at 4 mph and 12% incline before lifting
Easy recovery run from the house. Typical slow start but got rolling and felt much better.
Recovery run from Downtown Huntersville through Vermillion after dropping the girls at school. Felt smooth and strides felt great.

17:21.6 5th OA, 1st AG. Ugh thought I was in a little better shape than this… I guess it’s a little better on paper than July 4th so I’ll take that. Also the first 5:18 felt so easy and smooth but that third mile needed to be at least 20” faster. Can it be fall yet? Long cool down along the light rail trail afterwards so that tomorrow I can just do a medium long run instead of a full blown 15+ miler.

Hilly 20km long run through Skybrook the day after the race. Started slow and kept the first half very easy. Second half got decently fast with just a tiny increase in intensity. I needed a confidence boosting day like this after yesterday’s race.
Got on the treadmill late but managed to get in two thirds of my planned workout. Felt okay once I got moving.

1’30” jog between reps and 4’ between sets. Started with the intent of doing 2 x 3 x 4’ but got out the door a few minutes late and didn’t do my math well when designing the workout so only did 2 reps for set number 2. Didn’t feel unusually good but hit the best paces I’ve hit in this type of workout in some time. Another good confidence restorer after Saturday.
Nice and easy run from downtown Huntersville through Vermillion. Did a good job keeping the effort really chill two days out from Around the Crown.
Another easy recovery run around the neighborhood. Early start so the early miles felt meh but felt good by the end. 6 x 15” strides afterwards felt really smooth.

Better than last weekend! So close to ducking under 36’ despite the brutal humidity. The sharpening must have helped. Now a couple of weeks to continue building before Chi-Town and hopefully much cooler weather.
A renewed focus on some quality Z2 and a few good long runs in these final weeks. Legs felt like they had lifted yesterday but with the nicer weather I was able to roll without much effort.

1’15” jog between reps and 4’ total jog between sets. Walked the recovery between the final two reps of the second set but went 5:20 or faster on 7 of 8 and the slowest one was only 5:22! Probably the best all around workout in quite some time. The temp in the 60s was real nice too 👌🏻
Easy miles at Triple C Beer Runners plus a few with Dan beforehand. Right ankle is still a little tight feeling and the heat was back in full force today.

Ugh, right ankle is big mad. It was a little mad Thursday during the Triple C run but day off from running and lifting didn’t fully resolve it. Legs felt as though I had lifted yesterday too and the humidity was back with a vengeance.
Uphill treadmill cross training session to take it easy on my right ankle. 4 mph the entire time and 10’ @ 12% incline, 10’ @ 13%, 10’ @ 14%, 15’ @ 15%.
Test run to see how the ankle is doing and it felt much better than Saturday. Still not quite as good as most of the cycle, so another few cross training days and PT on Thursday.
Another uphill treadmill session to keep the load on my ankle lower this week. 4 mph the entire time and 10’ @ 13% incline, 10’ @14%, and 20’ @ 15%.
Another test run ahead of PT this afternoon. This felt even better than Tuesday and walking around the ankle feels much better, hopefully another week and some PT will have it right as rain.

Managed to squeeze in my uphill treadmill session in the late afternoon. Had intended on doing it in the morning but the pest control tech came early. Felt good outside of being really hot and sweaty in the garage at 4:00.

Longer run with Christo, Zach, and Tyler from the park and ride in Huntersville. Right ankle felt pretty good particularly for the first 7-8 miles, felt a little worse those last couple of miles. Fitness seems to be holding up fine though.
Easy 20’ uphill treadmill before some calf raises. 4 mph and 13% incline the whole time. Right ankle was not bad getting out of bed this morning but still playing it safe the next few days at least.
